content: Our approach to learn the initial foreign word embeddings $_f \in ^{|V_f| \times d}$ is based on the idea of mapping the trained English word embeddings $_e \in ^{|V_e| \times d}$ to $_f$ such that if a foreign word and an English word are similar in meaning then their embeddings are similar. Borrowing the idea of universal lexical sharing from BIBREF11, we represent each foreign word embedding $_f[i] \in ^d$ as a linear combination of English word embeddings $_e[j] \in ^d$
